_note: THE INDUSTRIAL FAMILY, 7 OF 10: THE SHIPMENT.

THE HOOK (10-28): the shipment is the water purifiers the plant built for the settlements nearby, and the radio is the settlement that put half down on them. Rewritten 2026-10-28 on his bar, "just about making each mission feel interesting in some way" (and "go ahead on the 7"): the draft had nothing in it worth mentioning afterwards.
The occupiers have a shipment staged to leave. Take their leader, lock the shipment down at the loading terminal,
and hold the way in when the people waiting for it arrive. The verb is LOCK.
Industrial dungeons (LocTypeDungeon_ThemeIndustrial, 20 per Eliza's count), vanilla interiors that carry the
delve markers today. Every word holds in any of them: nothing names the site, the faction or what the plant
made; everything a line points at is placed. Pay: med, capped.

place._theme: Industrial dungeons; the delve marker set.

prose.name: Seizure: Purifier Shipment on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The <Place> built a run of water purifiers for the settlements nearby before the occupiers took it. Now the whole run is staged to go to whoever pays most.
prose.card: Seizure contract. A shipment of water purifiers staged at the <Place> on <Planet> must not leave. Lock it down at the loading terminal and hold until it is secured. Payment on contract completion.

beats.objective: Defeat the occupiers' leader at the <Place>
beats.journal: The occupiers' leader at the <Place> is dead. Her shipment is still staged to go.
say: She's down? Then the shipment's next. Lock it at the loading terminal before anyone else can send it.

beats.objective: Lock the shipment at the loading terminal
beats.journal: The shipment is locked at the terminal. Nobody can send it now without a code they don't have, and the settlements get their water.
beats.name: Loading Terminal
say: It's locked. Their buyer's ship has just set down outside and nobody's told them yet, so they're going to come in angry.

beats.journal: The shipment at the <Place> is locked down, and the people who came to collect it went home empty.
say: That's the last of them. We'll have the purifiers out of there by morning, and there'll be clean water on every homestead by the end of the week.

broadcast: Every one of those purifiers was built for us, and we'd put half down before they took the place. Now they're staged for a buyer who's landing tonight, so lock the shipment at the loading terminal before anyone gets it on board.
_speech: On a board the broadcast waits for him at the site. Not yet heard in game; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency in a voiced line.
